reviews.text: Dr. Robins is the absolute best with all my pups! It’s safe to say she’s a Golden Retriever whisperer.

No waiting time , was seen right away as scheduled.
The doctor explains everything thoroughly .
All  personnel were helpful . The place is clean
Dr Ortega is caring, knowledgeable and brings a lot of good energy to the room.
Thank you for your amazing review, Sarah! We love what we do and are glad to be here for you and your pet!
Love everyone here!  Dr Diaz-Cruz is the best. Everyone is so caring

We couldn’t be happier with Dr. Ortega and the whole team. During this most recent visit, I even heard someone singing to the animals in the back room! You can tell they love what they do. Very highly recommend.
Dr. Karpinski is a consummate, caring professional. No one beats her experience and expertise as a veterinary ophthalmologist
Dr. Robins is a kind and caring veterinarian with a calming presence for both the dog as well as the owner.  She is incredible.
Dr Ortega is wonderful and so are the assistants. You can tell they love what they do.
Very good service
Love that you can book appointments online. Office staff friendly, convenient parking. Dr Jovanny Quesada is careful, caring, and a great diagnostician.
Dr. Karpinski is awesome and very thorough, she’s taken care of 4 of my senior fur babies.
Love this place. Staff is great, have dealt with multiple doctors and they’ve been amazing. My dog loves coming here.
Dr Ana Cruz has been our doctor for more than 6 years. She’s very knowledgeable and always has a smile on her face. Rio (our golden) loves her.
Dr. Karpinski is a genius when it comes to eye issues. As long as she is at Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital, I will continue to bring my dog.
Dr. Diaz-Cruz took her time to listen to us and to physically check out pet.
I have been using Pinecrest Vets for 25(ish) years.  Love them.
Very friendly staff greeting you as soon as you arrive. Hardly any waiting to be seen. They make sure that all pets feel welcome and safe and loved. The service is professional and thorough.
Love this place! Especially Dr. Quesada. He has been very loving with my dog and has kept him healthy thanks to his empathy and knowledge. Bless you Dr. Quesada ❤️
Service and dr attention was great! Dr Karpinski took care not only of my dogie eyes also all other problems. I am really gratefull for her worries and recommendations.
As always, the visit was fantastic. Very good attention and care for my little Bella and always great advice for her care at home

We decided to take our 13 y/o Chihuahua to get her first in depth eye check up. She wasn't having any specific issues but since she's getting older we wanted to see where she was at with her vision. I did a ton of research since I always want the best of the best for our girl. I'm so glad we went to Dr. Karpinski! She is so knowledgeable & professional (board certified vet ophthalmologist!). We loved that she explained each step of the exams she performed and what the results meant in a way we could understand. She put us at ease and recommended a few things that will help keep our aging pup's eyes healthy. The office was clean, the front desk staff were great and overall we had a wonderful experience. Oh and the price was reasonable for the services provided. We won't be taking our baby anywhere else! :)

We take your feedback seriously and would appreciate the opportunity to discuss your concerns. Unfortunately, we are unable to identify you as a client based on the account name this review is posted from, so we kindly ask that you give us a call at your convenience.

I had a very good experience with this vet.  Dr Alexander and her assistant took good care of Mini.  They were thoughtful, thorough and friendly.  Mini was comfortable with them.  Dr Alexander is knowledgeable and helpful. The location is clean and the front desk is welcoming and professional.  I highly recommend this veterinary practice.
Very good service, I didn't have to wait for my appointment, all the staff are friendly and I found the prices very competitive. I will return for my second consultation with the ophthalmologist.
Dr. Karpinski is amazing, love her!  Her genuine care and precision testing was admirable.  I am in awe of her and the knowledge she possesses and have highly recommended her to friends.

Ive been with them since 2023 and they’re incredible. Sending updates consistently if I’m keeping my dog there for the day. They are real honest people. They keep it light but get emotional with you if the news is heartbreaking. They aren’t just out to get your money they really truly care for you and your pet. They never make you feel like a burden and are so so sweet. They are attentive and adore taking care of every pet. I can’t thank them enough. 100/10 recommend. Trust your gut and fi with them. I promise they’ll never disappoint! <4

All the staff members are kind and helpful always. Dr. Diaz-Cruz is just wonderful. She truly loves what she does! It shows in how she treats our dog and how willing she is to give of her time to provide a thorough explanation of his care every single time we visit.
Dr. Robbins is a godsend. She’s an amazing, caring veterinarian! It’s way more than a business to her. She truly loves animals.!
We're glad to hear you had a great experience at Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital.
Dr Karpinski is my choice for eye care for pets.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to Dr. Lorraine Karpinski and the entire team at Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital for the incredibly professional and compassionate care they have provided to Cody.

From day one, Dr. Karpinski has demonstrated exceptional expertise, patience, and dedication. She took the time to carefully examine his eye, explain all the options, and answer our questions with honesty and compassion.

What I appreciate most is that she didn't rush into a drastic decision. Although Cody's case is complex, Dr. Karpinski continues to fight to give him the best chance of preserving his eye, if possible, always prioritizing his well-being and quality of life.

Thank you for the excellent care, clear communication, and love you show your patients. I highly recommend Dr. Karpinski to anyone needing specialized veterinary ophthalmological care. Cody is in the best hands.
Compassionate and super sweet treatment for our dog. The technician was as wonderful as they come.
Dr. Ortega always kind.an patient with my super energetic pup

Dr Ortega was once again phenomenal. She cannot control the high  prices all pet owners are facing but it would be hard to find a more competent caring vet. I respect her and appreciate the things she does for me and my dogs   I also very much appreciate Dr Robbin for coming to my home to put my 15 year old dog to sleep because she could no longer stand up on her own (75 lbs   i had no choice) She provides a valuable service and was very kind and compassionate)

Extremely rude. One of their vets (the most senior) accused us of being the cause for cancer in our dog because we did not spay her when she was young. Which by the way she was wrong and misdiagnosed her, saying it was cancer without doing any tests or biopsy, when it wasn’t! Separately years later we called their office about another pet (we forgot it was the same office and they could not know who we were as we have a different number now) and I simply politely asked if they carry a specify vaccine manufacturer (since some vaccines cause more side effects than others), and I hear in the background someone yelling « what difference does it make » and then click, they just hang up!!  Needless to say I will not be recommending them to anyone. It’s a shame because they used to have a decent reputation but this is what this practice has come to. Blaming distressed and caring pet lovers and hanging up on new customers. THERE ARE PLENTY OF VERY GOOD VETS OUT THERE. Just Keep looking. Believe all the 1 star reviews. I was not going to leave a review years ago, but this is well warranted.

EDIT: you responded that you would address these concerns and reach out but didn’t… And how about you don’t treat clients like that in the first place.

Im in love with Dr Robins and Krystal. Despite my demeanor at the time, since the concern was my lil one, they both but a smile on my face. Dr Robins was extremely thorough with the time and effort she placed on my lil one. They were both on their knees and it made me very comfortable and knew he was in good hands. Definitely  a return client!!! Thank you 😇

Had a very nice visit with my little dog Skyler.
Dr. Robins was excellent.
We love Dr Ortega! Our labs are brothers and are very hard to tell apart, but Dr. Ortega always calls them by name and is so good with them! And—The front desk always makes time for us when we need.
Dr Quesada is the most compassionate vet. He takes his time to assess, explain his findings,  and treatment plan. He's transparent and treats all pets as if they were his own.

All the vets at Pinecrest are top notch. This time I saw Dr. Karpinski, Ophthalmologist, for my dogs eye injury.  She lives up to her reputation for being the best in Florida and Pinecrest Vet's are blessed to have her. She is straight up no nonsense here are the facts and what needs to be done. Have seen here several times for my cats and dogs and she has always provided the best care with positive results.

I had been bringing my dog Robin to this clinic for years, and the way they handled things after his passing was appalling. I informed them via email that Robin had passed away, and not only did they ignore my message, but they also never sent any kind of sympathy note. After being a long-time client, the complete lack of compassion was shocking and extremely disappointing.
Customer service has also gone downhill. The office manager, Adriana, in particular, was consistently rude, aggressive, and offensive in her interactions. Instead of treating clients with care, she made the experience stressful and unpleasant.
On top of that, the clinic has started charging $10 for every prescription renewal if you choose not to buy medications directly from them. This feels like an unnecessary money grab and does not reflect a customer-first approach.
This clinic has lost my trust. When we adopt again, we will absolutely take our pets elsewhere. If you value compassion, professionalism, and respect, I do not recommend this place.
Dr Diaz always makes me feel confident with decisions that need to be made for my pets.
Dr. Robins and the entire staff including the front desk and vet techs always go over and beyond with their friendliness, professionalism and care of all my pets!!
Dr Alexander is exceptional.

This is a repost of a prior rating as I cannot think of anything to add:
We have been using Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital for many years now. Everyone there, from the front desk personnel to the technicians and assistants have always treated us with courtesy, care, professionalism, and compassion.
Our veterinarian, Dr. Robins, has been caring for our pets (and us!) for many years. When she started at this hospital a number of years ago, we followed her from her prior hospital and she is the reason we are at PVH. Aside from being fortunate enough to receive the excellent medical care she provides, she is one of the most caring and compassionate individuals that we have ever come to know. Because of her, our pets have enjoyed an amazing quality of life, and we, as well as our pets, have been the beneficiaries of that.
This hospital is highly recommended for veterinary care, and, in particular, so is Dr. Robins.
I didn’t like the doctor was in a rush, and barely touched the dog to examine him.

Dr Karpinski is a wonderful ophthalmologist! She is simply amazing! I highly recommend her.

Dr Karpinski was so kind, gentle and caring when she performed the yearly eye exam on my Bimini Lou, the Gorgeous Gypsy Girl.  Bimini Lou is a German Shorthaired Pointer; she trusted and liked Dr Karpinski, which means a lot to me.  Bimini Lou stayed so calm and still for the exam that it was incredible!  I imagine that Bimini Lou was reflecting the cool calmness Dr. Karpinski possesses.

After the detailed exam, Dr Karpinski took her time and explained everything clearly to me, so I completely understood the diagnosis and what to expect in the future.  I felt valued and never felt rushed. It was extremely clear that she cares about her patients as she provides professional, quality care to them.

This was our second visit to see her and was very similar to the first.  We will continue visiting yearly.

A heartfelt Thank-You, to Dr Karpinski and all of the kind staff at Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital, for taking such good care of us, it's so greatly appreciated!
Great Dr she is very knowledgeable and made my visit very easy and helpful would definitely recommend this hospital ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Dr karpinski and Dr Sloane are fabulous people and vets. They really care for your pet knowing how important they are to you and your family. Would not go anywhere else for my pets!!!
Staff is fast and professional. Dr. Karpinski explains everything well and her knowledge reassures me my cat’s care is in good hands.

Excellent !!! I'm really appreciate it everything they have been doing for my dog in the last 13 years. They are the best.  Super Professionals.  Very kind, friendly staff and very helpful. Thank you so much.

I want to say a very big thank you to the staff. My family member was on the way to hospice and wanted her dog to be there with her when she passed away but she did not know where her dog’s vaccine papers were for rabies and she lost the tag. I called and told them the issue and within the hour I was able to get her baby vaccinated and chipped. She passed away last week but got her final goodbye because of their help. They were kind beyond measure and I would recommend their services to everybody.

Wonderful staff, wonderful doctor, all around amazing.

Thank you all so much.
Always a pleasure to see Dr Robins and get my little Amy checked out.
Dr Karpinski provide quality treatment plan for Sybil, her eye site is improving in one eye, very good news. Staff is considered and very courteous
I've been here three times so far, and it's always been a pleasure and very organized. Dr. Karpinski is very knowledgeable and works alongside an amazing staff.

In what amounted to - in my eyes - an emergency visit, my precious little old kitty cat was approached and handled so lovingly by everyone here. From the receptionist who acknowledged me in anticipation as I was coming through the door (I'd called ahead), to the tech (Mercedes), to certainly Dr Alexander, my kitty and I were warmly brought into the facility with a kind, empathetic understanding of the situation.  They thoroughly examined and assessed my cat's condition, and offered detailed options based on their findings. Yes, all were professional, but their hearts were what shone through...my immense gratitude to Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital...
It was my first time here,  the service was excellent. They were very punctual, great doctor very knowledgeable. I am very pleased. Will continue to come back.
Very nice.  She gave me great meds and my dogs eye sight is improving
Dr. Quezada is the absolute best. He really cares for your Pet and takes his time to explain everything without rushing. I highly recommend him.

We are beyond grateful to Pinecrest Vets and Dr. Robins, who has never given up on our very anxious pup Simba, who is not only anxious, but he is big and strong! Dr. Robins, and Derwin and Krystal and Mary Jane, THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU for all of your incredible kindness and patience with Simba!!!
Honestly, you are all so outrageously kind and patient and amazing. Dr. Robins, thank you so very much for not firing us as patients and for not giving up on Simba! Watching you today was stunning - you are gentle and firm and so fast and so comforting!!!! He was - always is with you - in the best hands EVER. We could not be luckier that you are his doctor. OUR CRAZY DOG. Derdwin - we could NOT have gotten him into the car without you, and if I had not seen how you picked him up and carried him, I would not have been able to do that to get him out of the car and into the house! You all are beyond wonderful, and Dr. Robins - there is no other vet with the patience and skill and kindness and humor you always have. We are beyond grateful. THANK YOU for taking such amazing care of our beloved, kooky pup!!

One of the best vet offices but specifically what keeps there is Dr. Salone Robbins. She's the most amazing vet, she's so knowledgeable, and extremely caring. She also does a ton for the community with homeless cats and donates her services to that. So honorable so I highly recommend it.

Superior, empathetic, courteous, amazing veterinary medical staff. Time is taken to carefully explain your options even if your options might be better served elsewhere. I cannot help but extol the virtue of these outstanding vets. 20 + years of consistent service. Compassionate & caring is the icing on the cake, just great vets!

I have been bringing my two dogs here for a couple years now, and had previously left a five star review. Unfortunately, it is clear that private equity has transformed what was a neighborhood vet into a profit-first enterprise. Annual checkups for my two dogs now cost in excess of $800. Everything is an upcharge and upsell. They do not honor email offers. There is zero personal relationship left. I will not be back.
Thank you for your generous review! We appreciate your feedback and hope to see you again soon!

Dr. Karpinski impressed us as highly knowledgeable and spent time explaining a complicated (for us) diagnosis. Also she demonstrated application of drops :)) Office staff was nice and NO Waiting a big plus!!
Always excellent care for my dog. A little expensive though.
Excellent and very caring facility, doctors and staff.  Always a great experience. Thumbs up,

Dr Robbins is superb. She’s takes care of our Zoe with great understanding and compassion  and always goes the extra mile. She is also a very intuitive vet, who thinks outside the box and doesn’t run unnecessary tests. Our Zoe is very medically compromised and Dr Robbins has helprd us manage her complex issues brilliantly. We’re so grateful.

The staff is amazingly cordial, efficient and genuinely nice people.  Dr. Karpinski is not only one of the best Vets I know, her intuition coupled with her extensive knowledge of veterinary ophthalmic medicine, and the psychological finess with which she handles discussing  delicate cases is simply outstanding.  ♥️
Amazing people; I wish I lived a little closer.  It is far for me, but absolutely worth the trip.  I would not trust any other Vet with my pet's or fosters' eyes.

Dr. Kaprinski the eye specialist knowledgable but does NOT DO EYE OPERATIONS anymore!! uptight personality making a comfortable experience disappointing. How can they market they operate on the eye if they don’t???

Dr. Diaz-Cruz and the wonderful team at Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital are truly amazing. Our little guy has been through a lot but is always excited to see his friends here. With knowledge, expertise and kindness, they make both the dog and his parents thankful.
Great experience. Loved Dr. Robins and her nurse.

Can’t say enough great things about Dr. Robins and the staff. Dr. Robins has been caring for our dogs for years. We currently have 4 dogs - including two medium size 14 year olds. As they’ve aged, she has done an incredible job helping us keep them happy and healthy and we are so grateful! She is an amazing Vet. We also love Derwin, one of the Vet Techs. You can see how much he loves our dogs. And the front desk is always friendly and helpful making visits and calls easy!

Got, a very professional experience.
Service from staff and Dr LK was as always extremely excellent.
Dr. Karpinsky is the best! She is extremely knowledgeable and thorough. She has great communication skills. My chihuahua, Rio, and I love her! Awesome experience, always!

I came here because my senior dog was recently diagnosed with severe glaucoma. The staff was very friendly.  Dr. Karpinski was Excellent. She was very thorough and honest about the prognosis of my dogs eye condition. I must say, I’m very happy with the treatment received at this office. And their prices are very, very reasonable. I live 30 minutes away, but I am considering switching my other two dogs to this vet office.

Had a wonderful visit just as always. They listened to my concerns and evaluated my dog to find what might be the causes of the situation. I would never go to another vet. Dr. Diaz-Cruz is a wonderful doctor and a very compassionate and caring person. They always make me feel comfortable and important.

I love Dr. Lorraine Karpinski, she’s the best and says it how it is. My dog is very difficult, “atrocious” as per Dr. Karpinski “ 🤣 .. but the Dr and team are ready to handle bad lil’ Ghost and their treatment has made all the difference in our pup’s eye health. It’s a long commute for us but I wouldn’t take him anywhere else. …

Our vet is Ana Cruz-Diaz, she is very thorough in her explanations.  She doesn’t rush you, takes her time with you.  She is very knowledgeable. She was a great help giving me suggestions  regarding my dog’s food, because she wasn’t eating.  It was a great help. Thank you! Also I want to mention, her assistant is very loving with my dog. So beautiful to see.

Dr. Alexander, Patient, and the entire team were amazing! Can’t say enough good stuff about this place. I drove an hour north to establish care for my pets at a vet down here because of their positive reviews, and I wasn’t disappointed.
Dr. Diaz-Cruz is a very caring and knowledgeable  Dr.    She took time in explaining and answering all my questions.

Everyone is so compassionate.  Dr. Diaz Cruz is fantastic!  The vet techs are very loving, knowledgeable and professional.  The front desk staff is efficient, effective and always helpful.  I have been going to Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital for many years and have always been confident of the care my dogs receive and always satisfied.
So lovely team... My puppy never afraid , just feels like a king... A  million of thanks...

Have been with these vets for many years. Would recommend to all! We also recently have worked with Dr Ortega and Dr Qasadas. Both are great! Tr entry started with Dr K the ophthalmologist. She is great with the dogs.

Wonderful veterinarians, tech and support staff.  My beautiful Persians have been treated by Dr. Sloane Robins for several years now.  I completely trust Dr. Robins with the care of my beloved cats and would absolutely recommend her to another cat or dog owner.  I believe she loves her work and cares for all our pets as if they were her own.
Office staff very nice, office clean and Dr Karpinski was extremely thorough and explained well.   She is amazing.  I would highly recommend this office.
Best experience always. The entire staff are great.
Great doctors! Super caring people….💛
Doctors and staff were courteous and professional. Dr Quesada listened to my concerns and was able to provide me with a diagnosis and treatment.

I highly recommend Dr. Karpinski. My dog had an eyelid tumor removal with her and everything went smoothly. She is knowledgeable and attentive, the whole team is great. Our dog is recovering well, the cut and stitches were really small and I appreciate all the care with her. If you are looking for a specialist in eyes, she is amazing.
Our rescued puppy’s 1st visit with Dr. Quesada. Great attention from doctor and staff. Good experience all around.

I brought my dog in as an emergency and everyone was very responsive, caring and diligent in diagnosing my dog’s problem. Dr. Ortega took a lot of time answering questions and sharing options for tests and care.  I am happy to say my dog is recovering and doing well.
Everyone at the office was so compassionate and understanding.

I normally don’t write reviews, but this experience is something I still can’t make peace with. I’m deeply disturbed by the insensitivity and lack of awareness shown by one particular staff member whose name I unfortunately do not know.
Recently, my mom had to make the heartbreaking decision to put down her beloved dog, Lola, who had been part of our family for over 10 years. She asked me to be by her side as she said her final goodbyes. The receptionists were compassionate and understanding, and the technician who assisted us was kind and thoughtful. She placed us in what we believed was a private, quiet room and brought blankets and towels to ensure Lola was comfortable during her final moments.
After the technician gently closed the door, my mom and I began praying—asking for peace for Lola and strength for our family as we prepared to say goodbye. Suddenly, and completely unexpectedly, we heard an employee singing loudly nearby. The noise was jarring and entirely inappropriate given the circumstances. It shattered the quiet, sacred moment we were trying to have with our dog.
Because of this disruption, my mom felt so uncomfortable and distressed that she cut her final moments with Lola short. What should have been a peaceful, respectful goodbye turned into a painful and rushed experience due to one employee’s complete lack of awareness and consideration.
While some of the staff showed genuine empathy, this incident left a lasting negative impression during one of the most difficult moments a family can experience. I truly hope the clinic addresses the importance of sensitivity and situational awareness, especially when clients are grieving the loss of a beloved pet.

Dr. Robins was excellent. She took great care to hear about my cat’s symptoms and came up with a plan to help her. I highly
Recommend.
They are great! We needed international travel documentation! It was easy.
Always a positive experience with Dr. Quesada at Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital.  Always patient and answers all our many questions.
Refused to give me a list of their recommended oncologists (as in ..they have more than one) … just because my dog wasn’t their patient …. Who wouldn’t want to help a suffering dog ….

We’ve been going to Pinecrest Vet and Dr. Ortega since shortly after we moved here a few years ago. Dr. Ortega and the team are the most compassionate, animal-loving and ethical veterinary team I’ve come across in all my years of having animals.

Our dog Poppy recently passed due to heart failure. In the weeks, months and years prior to her death and in her decline, Dr. Ortega was patient with my questions and helped guide me in compassionate care. In Poppy’s last weeks, she answered my calls and emails at all times of the day and spent countless hours with me helping me to figure out the best time to let Poppy go, clearing her schedule and never making me feel rushed.

Ultimately, when Poppy passed, she canceled other (non-work) plans very last-minute and stayed in the office for Poppy despite not even being scheduled to work. She helped us to give Poppy a peaceful goodbye, again and again telling us to take all the time we needed with her.

The rest of the staff— from the vet techs and nurses to the amazing ladies at the front desk— are equally lovely!

We could not have asked for a more caring vet in the darkest and most difficult time for a pet owner. I tell anyone who asks that she (and the whole staff) is the best vet ever. If I could give 6 stars, I would!
Thanks for your positive feedback!
The staff were friendly. They answered all my questions. It was easy to make an appointment.
Dr. Ortega is the best!
Dr Quesada, Andres, and the team's holistic approach means my dog can have the benefit of their expertise. I appreciate the attention to and patience with his specific behavioral issues.
Dr. Robins and Pinecrest Vets staff are the best!

Love Dr Ortega and her staff.
My dog is well taken care of there.

Amazing. We love Dr. Robins. I have three cats. Two of them are siberians and I struggled so much finding a vet who is truly experienced with cats. Not all breeds are made equal and few vets pay attention to this. I am very picky and I expect a certain standard and transparency from all vets. My experience has been great so far

We’ve been going to this hospital for many years. Dr. Robins is wonderful!!
Very nice staff as well
Very knowledgeable and caring.

EVERYONE at Pinecrest Veterinary Hospital is absolutely wonderful!  Our girl went in for dental surgery (she is 14 going on 15) and could not have been in better hands.  The level of care is supremen and their communication could not be better.

Have always found Pinecrest Vet. to be Professional, top quality, reliable, responsive and good value. Both our dogs always get superb treatment and affectionate care by Dr. Robbins and the Staff - they (almost) don't mind going to the Vet. now!
Always courteous and on time with the appointment.

I've been going to Pinecrest Vet Hospital for years with multiple different kitties.  I highly recommend them because of their caring nature and very friendly staff who put you at ease with your beloved pets.
The staff was kind and courteous. God is right in and doctor. Elizabeth was great answered all our questions and took all the time we needed would highly recommend.
Professional and timely service. I have the utmost confidence in the care given to my dog by Dr. Diaz-Cruz, who has been our dog's vet for over 8 years. I would recommend!

Excelent

As usual our last visit to Pinecrest Veterinary was great. Dr. Quesada is always very happy to see Fluffy, my lovely mini poodle which is a tornado. I reccommend them highly.

I highly recommend and very economical.

I love love Dr. Karpinski, she’s the best.

Such a caring and professional place. Lovely front desk ladies and doctors. I just went for an emergency and couldn’t be happier.

Very professional, staff incredible nice

Michele
Staff is very nice , Dr.Ortega is a gem !

Dr. Ortega and staff looked over all the documents/tests from the ER and worked tirelessly the entire week to help get our dog back to health. We have no doubt they saved his life.

We took our dogs for an Annual check up and to update their Rabies Tags. Dr. Diaz Cruz is a true professional with a caring approach to our dogs in order to make them feel comfortable. We are happy that she is our dog’s Vet.

I have been bringing my French Bulldog here for the past six months after he was diagnosed with glaucoma in one of his eyes. Before finding Dr.Karpinski, I saw two other ophthalmologists who, although knowledgeable, immediately recommended eye removal. Wanting to explore every possible option before making such a big decision, I sought out a third opinion—and I’m so grateful I did.

I found Dr.Karpinski through a Reddit thread where multiple people highly recommended her for her expertise, experience, and thoughtful approach to care. Since our first visit in November 2024, I have never looked back. She is thorough, patient, and genuinely cares for her patients. Thanks to her guidance, we have successfully managed my dog’s eye pressure, and while he is blind in that eye, he remains happy, playful, and comfortable—all without needing surgery.

What I appreciate most is that she didn’t rush into removal as the only option. Instead, she took the time to find the right medications and treatment plan that worked for my dog, allowing us to manage his condition effectively.

I’ve seen some reviews mentioning that she isn’t the "friendliest," but I couldn’t disagree more. She is kind, compassionate, and incredibly skilled—and at the end of the day, that’s what truly matters when it comes to your pet’s health.

Beyond the excellent care, the front desk staff is friendly, and the facility is clean and well-maintained. Finding parking can be tricky during lunch hours, so I recommend arriving about 30 minutes before your appointment to ensure you have enough time.

I am beyond grateful to have found Dr.Karpinski, and I highly recommend her to anyone looking for an experienced and dedicated veterinary ophthalmologist.
